title: The Real Routine of Cleopatra
hook: Cleopatra spoke nine languages and ran the Mediterranean's richest economy, yet myths reduce her to donkey milk baths.

scenes.text: Popular culture remembers Cleopatra as a glamorous seductress, but historical accounts by Plutarch describe a brilliant intellectual and statesman.

scenes.text: Her day began at dawn inspecting the royal treasury books and regulating the vast Nile grain trade that fed millions across the Mediterranean.
